Hitar Dashboard

100% Free & Open

Configure multi-engine backends, zero-paid API rules, domain preferences, and cache tuning.

Zero Paid API Keys Required

Hitar uses built-in free web translation engines (Google Free Engine, Lingva, LibreTranslate). Optional local Docker self-hosting guide:

docker run -p 5000:5000 libretranslate/libretranslate

Free Translation Engines & Priority

Endpoints are queried in priority order. If one fails or rate-limits, Hitar automatically fails over to the next engine seamlessly.

Always Translate Domains

Pages on these domains automatically translate upon load.

Never Translate Domains

Translation is disabled on these domains.

Cache & Batch Tuning

IndexedDB Cache
0 / 20,000 entries

LRU eviction automatically purges oldest entries when capacity is reached.

2000 chars

Controls maximum characters sent per translation HTTP request.
